ayahs.2: no one can deny it has come.
ayahs.3: It will bring some low and raise others high.
ayahs.4: When the earth is shaken with a violent shake,
ayahs.5: and the mountains are crushed to pieces,
ayahs.7: you will be divided into three groups:
ayahs.8: the people of the right—how blessed they will be;
ayahs.9: the people of the left—how wretched they will be;
ayahs.10: and the foremost in faith will be the foremost in Paradise.
ayahs.11: They are the ones brought nearest to Allah,
ayahs.14: and a few from later ones.
ayahs.15: These opening letters—known as the muqatta'at—are among the signs whose full meaning Allah kept with Himself. They open the surah by reminding the reader that this Book is from beyond human authorship: approach it with humility, not arrogance.
ayahs.18: with cups, pitchers, and wine from a flowing stream—
ayahs.19: that causes neither headache nor intoxication.
ayahs.21: and meat from any bird they desire.
ayahs.23: like hidden pearls—radiant companions untouched and pure.
ayahs.24: a reward for what they used to do.
ayahs.25: There they will hear no idle or sinful talk—
ayahs.27: And the people of the right—how blessed they will be!
ayahs.30: extended shade that never runs out,
ayahs.33: never out of season nor forbidden,
ayahs.35: We have created their companions with perfect form,
ayahs.36: These opening letters—known as the muqatta'at—are among the signs whose full meaning Allah kept with Himself. They open the surah by reminding the reader that this Book is from beyond human authorship: approach it with humility, not arrogance.
ayahs.38: for the people of the right.
ayahs.40: and a multitude from later ones.
ayahs.41: And the people of the left—how wretched they will be!
ayahs.42: In scorching heat and boiling water,
ayahs.43: in the shade of black smoke,
ayahs.45: Before this they lived in luxury,
ayahs.47: They used to ask mockingly: When we are dead and turned to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected?
ayahs.50: will surely be gathered for the appointed Day.
ayahs.52: will eat from the trees of Zaqqum,
ayahs.54: then drink boiling water on top of that,
ayahs.56: This will be their hospitality on the Day of Judgment.
ayahs.57: It is We who created you. Will you not then believe in resurrection?
ayahs.58: Have you considered what you emit?
ayahs.59: Is it you who create it, or are We the Creator?
ayahs.60: We have decreed death for all of you, and We are not outstripped
ayahs.61: from transforming you and recreating you in forms you do not know.
ayahs.62: You already know how you were first created. Will you not then take heed?
ayahs.63: Have you considered what you sow?
ayahs.64: Is it you who make it grow, or are We the Grower?
ayahs.65: If We willed, We could reduce it to chaff and you would be left lamenting,
ayahs.66: We have truly suffered a loss,
ayahs.68: Have you considered the water you drink?
ayahs.69: Is it you who sent it down from the clouds, or are We Who sent it?
ayahs.70: If We willed, We could make it bitter. Will you not then show shukr?
ayahs.71: Have you considered the fire you kindle?
ayahs.72: Is it you who grew its trees, or are We the Grower?
ayahs.73: We made it a reminder and a provision for travellers.
ayahs.74: So glorify the Name of your Rabb, the Magnificent.
ayahs.75: I swear by the positions of the stars—
ayahs.76: and this, if you knew, is a mighty oath—
ayahs.77: that this is a noble Qur'an,
ayahs.79: touched by none except the purified angels.
ayahs.80: A revelation from the Rabb of all that exists.
ayahs.81: How can you take this message lightly,
ayahs.82: and repay the provision Allah gave you with denial?
ayahs.83: Why then—when the soul reaches the throat at death,
ayahs.85: and We are nearer to the dying person than you, though you cannot see—
ayahs.86: if you are not subject to Our command as you claim,
ayahs.87: bring that soul back, if you are truthful.
ayahs.88: If the deceased is among those brought near to Allah,
ayahs.89: then comfort, fragrance, and a Garden of Bliss.
ayahs.90: And if among the people of the right,
ayahs.91: then peace to you from the people of the right.
ayahs.92: But if among the misguided deniers,
ayahs.96: So glorify the Name of your Rabb, the Magnificent.
